name: Magilla AI Usage
author: Leonardo Bassanello (xFurti)
description: Magilla-themed Omarchy bar widget that detects AI coding tools and shows subscription usage, remaining quota, and reset countdowns in one place.

barWidget.description: Detect Grok, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and friends. Pin 1–3 providers on the bar, open a Magilla panel for the rest.

schema.label: Bar providers (comma-separated, max 3)
schema.description: Provider ids to show on the bar, for example grok,cursor,claude. Leave empty to auto-pick.

schema.label: Bar display style
schema.description: percent = used quota, remaining = leftover quota, compact = colored numbers only.

schema.label: Show tools that are installed but not signed in
